shared_context: Aoife Byrne is a shortlisted candidate for a position. She has listed two referees. The recruiter needs to speak with both referees before the interview panel meets next Thursday (2026-08-20). The recruiter has been making calls to the referees. The referees have not yet returned the calls as of the simulation start time.

starting_events.description: The recruiter has already attempted to call both referees but has not yet received a return call from either.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-08-20T09:00:00+01:00, the persistent event history shows that both Referee 1 and Referee 2 have returned the recruiter's calls (i.e., each has had a conversation with the recruiter initiated by the referee returning a call). Otherwise resolve NO.
